audit.why: Level 1 is a wash, then Cassiopeia owns every stage: Nautilus is a tank with one telegraphed engage and no way to answer ramping magic DoT, and her Serpentine Grace speed dodges the hook. Consistent with 61.04% over 77 games, the strongest row in this slice, and both layers already read Cassiopeia from level 2 on.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dredge Line is named matchup-defining in four fields with neither a cooldown nor a range, and Titan's Wrath never appears at all despite being what makes his early trades survivable.
audit.why: Dredge Line is 14/13/12/11/10s at 1150 range. The range is the important half: 1150 out-reaches Noxious Blast's 850, so 'stay at max Q range' is not actually safe from the hook, and the 14-second downtime is the real free window. Titan's Wrath is a flat 12s shield.
audit.corrected: 14s and 1150 range added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, wants.you[1], dontsFull[1].d and spikes[3].text; Titan's Wrath and its 12s added to spikes[2].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. First, slot confusion inside a single sentence: spikes[3].text says 'a blind hook (Q) into Staggering Blow root, then Dredge Line (E) and Depth Charge (R)'. Dredge Line IS the Q hook; his E is Riptide. Second, mid and wants.you[0] both say Miasma 'grounds his Dredge Line dash'. Dredge Line is not a dash.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Q Dredge Line hurls an anchor - colliding with an enemy pulls them and Nautilus together, colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus toward it. Its flags are projectile, knockup, hardCC and terrain, with no dash among them, so there is no movement ability for Miasma's grounding to disable. Nothing in Nautilus's kit is a dash. What Miasma genuinely does is slow him out of the 1150 hook range. Telling the player the grounding stops his engage is the most dangerous kind of wrong: it invites her to stand still inside a cloud that is not protecting her.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text now names Riptide correctly and Dredge Line as the Q; mid, wants.you[0] and dontsFull[1].d now say the slow holds him outside 1150 rather than that the grounding stops him.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text told the player to 'stun the whole cone mid-animation' while he 'tries to ult', and wrote Twin Fang as 'Twin Fangs' in four places.
audit.why: Depth Charge is a fired shockwave that chases its target; once it is out, stunning Nautilus does not recall it. The reliable instruction is to stun him on the hook landing, before Depth Charge is cast at all - which is also when he is closest and facing her, the condition Petrifying Gaze requires.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and whys[4] now say stun as the hook lands, before Depth Charge; the ability name is Twin Fang throughout the edited fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dredge Line's terrain behaviour was never mentioned.
audit.why: Colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus toward the wall, which is a second approach angle over a wall that Cassiopeia - who has no dash - cannot answer with mobility. The missing-interactions file flags exactly this as a retreat-cut for her.
audit.corrected: Folded into spikes[3].text as the reason not to hug walls or facecheck brush.

edits.before: His real threat is a blind hook (Q) into Staggering Blow root, then Dredge Line (E) and Depth Charge (R) chaining you long enough for a jungler to collapse — never facecheck brush and hug your side of the wave when his jungle is unknown.
edits.after: His real threat is a blind Dredge Line (Q) at 1150 range into the Staggering Blow root, then Riptide's slow and Depth Charge chaining you long enough for a jungler to collapse — never facecheck brush, and don't hug walls he can anchor to.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze (R) answers his all-in: when he hooks in and tries to ult, face him and stun the whole cone mid-animation, then chain Twin Fangs through the stun before his tank stats matter.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze (R) answers his all-in: stun him the frame the hook lands, before Depth Charge is even cast, then chain Twin Fang through the stun while his tank stats do nothing.

edits.before: Liandry's or Malignance plus your AP-converted move-speed scaling makes your %-health burn chew through his low early MR — Twin Fang refunds keep firing, so an immobile tank in your poison just melts.
edits.after: Liandry's or Malignance plus your AP-converted move speed makes %-health burn chew his low early MR — and Titan's Wrath is a 12s shield your refunded Twin Fang simply out-paces, so an immobile tank in your poison melts.

edits.before: This is your lane to take over. Drop Miasma (W) on the ground between you — it grounds his Dredge Line dash and slows him, so he can't stroll in for a free hook — then poke with Q and chain Twin Fangs that refund their cooldown on every poisoned tick. A tank standing still in your poison just melts. At 6, hold Petrifying Gaze: if he hooks in and tries to ult you, face him and stun the cone through his cast, then keep firing Twin Fangs while your move speed keeps you outside his Dredge Line range. His resistances mean less than you think once Liandry's burn and your AP scaling come online.
edits.after: This is your lane to take over. Drop Miasma (W) on the ground between you — he has no dash for it to ground, but the slow keeps him outside Dredge Line's 1150 range so he can't stroll in for a free hook — then poke with Q and chain Twin Fang refunds off every poisoned tick. A tank standing still in your poison just melts. At 6, hold Petrifying Gaze: stun him the moment the hook lands, before Depth Charge is cast, then keep firing Twin Fang while your move speed carries you back out. His resistances mean less than you think once Liandry's burn and your AP scaling come online.

notes: Two hard errors here. spikes[3].text contradicted itself inside one sentence, calling Dredge Line both the Q hook and the E; his E is Riptide. And mid plus wants.you[0] claimed Miasma grounds 'his Dredge Line dash' — Nautilus has no dash anywhere in his kit, so the grounding was protecting nothing while the player stood still in the cloud. This is the fourth matchup in my slice where the generic Cassiopeia grounding line was applied to a dashless champion, which supports the generator root cause the Mel-side audit identified in champ-data/_gen-engine.js. Not verified and therefore not claimed: whether Petrifying Gaze can interrupt Depth Charge's cast, and whether Titan's Wrath's shield blocks the initial Twin Fang or only reduces it.
